name: checkpoint
description: Persist resumable progress for a long-running task. Writes the typed progress.resumable block (cursor, done/total, accumulator, last_slice_units, next). Only available on tasks marked resumable. Use periodically and before running low on turn budget.

inputs.accumulator: object[]? (optional inline slice results — defaults to [] when omitted; after spill use { kind: document, path, section? } object instead)
